projects.title: CloudHire: Serverless Job Board Platform (Next.js + AWS)
description: 🚀 Cloud-Native Architecture: Designed 100% Event-driven Serverless system on AWS, completely eliminating server management burden (NoOps) and idle costs (Zero Idle Cost).
⚡️ High Availability & Scale: Built RESTful API with API Gateway & Lambda handling thousands of requests/second, combined with DynamoDB On-demand for <10ms latency.

🛡️ DevSecOps & Observability: Applied Zero Trust model (Cognito, IAM Least Privilege, CloudFront OAC) and established automated monitoring system (CloudWatch Alarms -> SNS) for instant error detection.

projects.title: BBCIncorp & Enterprise Ecosystem (Migration & Cloud Infrastructure)
description: 🏗️ Infrastructure Modernization: Led Migration process from Legacy System to Hybrid Cloud architecture (Next.js + Headless CMS) for large enterprise project chain (BBCIncorp, NovaGroup, Visa2Asia).
⚙️ CI/CD & Automation: Designed automated Build & Deploy process with AWS CodeBuild, pushing Static Assets to S3/CloudFront, reducing deployment time from 30 minutes to 5 minutes.
🔐 Security Architecture: Deployed CMS infrastructure in Private Subnet (EC2), secured via NAT Gateway and IP access restrictions, ensuring absolute security for enterprise data.

projects.title: IELTS Intensive Academy - Automated VPS Infrastructure & Optimization
description: ⚙️ Infrastructure Automation: Built Bash Scripts to automate entire server Provisioning process: Install LAMP Stack (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP), configure VirtualHost and system permissions in <5 minutes.
🔐 Security Hardening: Established OS and Web Server level security: Auto SSL configuration (Certbot), optimized Security Headers (X-Frame, X-XSS), and strict permissions for Webroot/Storage.
📈 Performance Tuning: Optimized Apache configuration (Gzip, Caching headers for Assets), fine-tuned MySQL Buffer Pool enabling website to handle stable load on EC2 t3.medium instance.
